sentence: A diák tegnap elolvasott egy érdekes könyvet.
note: smoke sentence; a/egy are DET; the joined preverb verb elolvasott lemmatises to elolvas
PROBE: házakban = ház + plural -ak + inessive -ban; olvastam = 1sg past indefinite of olvas
negation separates the preverb: el is compound:preverb on olvasta and joins. nem is ADV (UD Hungarian) and mines, left unasserted
preverb before the auxiliary fog: the arc goes to the infinitive olvasni; fog is AUX
the -e question clitic is split off by spaCy's hu tokenizer and tagged ADV; the hu post-pass demotes it to PART
all-caps cue: tagged from the lowercased copy, so -E splits and demotes too

sentence: ŐSZINTÉN SZÓLVA NEM ÉRTEM AZ ŰRHAJÓT.
note: all-caps cue with Ő and Ű: lower() round-trips, and the sentence-final dot splits off in the lowercased copy

sentence: Pl. az alma és a körte stb. gyümölcs.
note: pl. and stb. stay dotted abbreviation tokens (X)
imperative of bejön: gyere lemmatises to jön; be is kept apart from the final dot because be is dropped from the abbreviation set

sentence: Meg kell csinálnom a házi feladatot.
note: meg is PART with compound:preverb on the inflected infinitive csinálnom
negation separates be from megyek
haza is a verbal prefix (en.wiktionary Appendix:Hungarian verbal prefixes); menni lemmatises to megy

sentence: Dr. Kovács kb. öt percet késett.
note: Dr. and kb. are dotted abbreviations (X); Kovács is PROPN; öt is NUM
út. is a spaCy hu tokenizer exception; út is an ordinary word (OpenSubtitles rank 801), dropped from the abbreviation set, so the dot splits off
hu has no letter-hyphen-letter infix, so the hyphenated adjective stays one token
sentence-initial capital: the lemmatiser is case-insensitive
vissza joins the infinitive adni across the auxiliary
ki as preverb (PART), not the interrogative pronoun
the appendix's own example verb; anyámat carries a possessive suffix
past tense jött lemmatises to jön

the ordinal 3. is tagged ADJ with lemma 3.; it holds no Latin letter, so LatinScript's contains_target_script gate (subtitle_parser should_include) keeps it out - the tagger-only probe does mine it, the real parser does not

sentence: Holnap is el kell mennünk a boltba.
note: el precedes the modal kell; the arc goes to mennünk
known model miss: the imperative csukd lemmatises to csukd, so the front is not becsuk (with a dictionary the join is unattested and csukd stays); left unasserted

sentence: A hívott szám nem érhető el.
note: head-POS gate: el hangs compound:preverb on the ADJ érhető, so PARTICLE_HEAD_POS skips the stash; el keeps its ADV tag and mines, elér never fronts (36 of 465 arcs)
two compound:preverb arcs on one head: the substrate keeps the first (volna, demoted to PART), so the front stays hisz and the second dependent el mines as ADV (4 heads in the corpus)
